scenario_reading: The scenario id encodes Syndra with the splinter option at 120 — the exact threshold at which the innate Transcendent tier engages. The cached wiki text for Syndra P states: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.' So in this scenario the passive is engaged, and 'derived order' names the ordering question of that +15% total-AP buff relative to the AP-derived damage rows.

independent_computation.step_1_what_syndra_P_is: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.P ('Transcendent') has four effect branches, none of which deals damage: (a) splinter collection (stacks to 120), (b) mana restore 20:255 by level, (c) '+15% ability power' at 120 splinters, (d) collection at max stacks grants no stacks but still restores mana. cost/cooldown/damageType are all null; targeting = 'Passive', affects = 'Self'. Therefore the passive's DAMAGE contribution in any rotation, single-target or AoE, is exactly 0.
independent_computation.step_2_the_leaf_is_not_a_damage_row: The observed value is the integer 1. No Syndra damage row can be 1. Using the cached leveling arrays at max ranks and 0 AP (a strict lower bound, since the scenario's AP is positive and the passive multiplies it by 1.15): Q 'Magic Damage' 230 (+70% AP), W 190 (+65% AP), E 200 (+60% AP), R 'Minimum Magic Damage' 480 (+60% AP, 3 spheres). Post-mitigation against a level-18 mid target (MR = 30 + 1.3 x 17 x (0.7025 + 0.0175 x 17) = 52.1, multiplier 100/(100+52.1) = 0.6575, per docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.1) these floor at 124.9 / 151.2 / 131.5 / 315.6. A rotation damage leaf therefore cannot be 1 by three orders of magnitude, and a passive damage leaf would be 0, not 1. The leaf is a count/flag-valued quantity for the passive slot, not damage.
independent_computation.step_3_the_sourced_count_for_syndra_P_is: Every count-like reading of the passive slot resolves to 1 from the cached wiki text, and to 1 only: (i) tier engagement — exactly one Transcendent tier exists at 120 splinters ('+15% ability power'), and it is active in this scenario, so an engaged/applied flag is 1; (ii) proc cadence — 'Dealing two instances of ability damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants 1 / 2 / 3 (based on level) Splinters. This cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds', with the cached per-target gate onTargetCdStatic = '8' (seconds). A single AoE rotation is ~2 s of casts (wiki castTime: E 0.25 s, R 0.25 s, Q 'none' with a 0.6 s sphere delay; docs/math-foundations.md Section 5 records the engine's 0.5 s inter-cast GCD estimate for a one-rotation spread), far inside the 8 s per-target gate, so the passive engages exactly once per target per rotation; (iii) rank — a passive has exactly one rank. Under all three the correct entry is 1.
independent_computation.step_4_why_absent_is_the_weaker_answer: With splinters = 120 the passive is materially engaged (it scales every AP row by 1.15) and the champion-audit record for Syndra lists P as a modeled slot ('P = 120-splinter +15% total AP BUFF', data/champion-audit/batch-6.json). A rotation breakdown that omits the slot entirely records nothing about a passive that is switched on in this exact scenario; recording 1 states, correctly and in a wiki-sourced way, that the Transcendent tier is engaged once in the AoE rotation.
